mockOrSyntheticEngines.claimed_capability: Two-way partitioned fluid-structure interaction solver with dynamic mesh morphing and Aitken relaxation

partialImplementations.claimed_capability: Spatial mapping of boundary forces from fluid faces to structural nodes, and structural displacements to fluid nodes

prioritizedRemediationRoadmap.action: Completed in SECP-ENGINE-QUALIFICATION-002-FSI-STRUCTURAL-SOLVER-QUALIFICATION-001 (Analytical rod test error < 0.0001%, NAFEMS Quad4 PASS).
Wire StructuralAnalysisEngine.runFEA into the iterative partitioned Gauss-Seidel loop, replacing stiffness = E * 1e-7 with actual FEA solution and unpenalized reaction forces.
Implement Laplacian / Spring boundary smoothing for fluid mesh vertex coordinates, check Jacobian determinant for inversion, and reject collapsed elements.
Implement genuine Aitken dynamic under-relaxation computing omega_k = -omega_{k-1} * (r_{k-1}^T * (r_k - r_{k-1})) / ||r_k - r_{k-1}||^2, residual monitoring, and divergence detection.
